meta.title: URPA Academy Software — The management platform for your sports academy
meta.description: Management software for sports academies: students, class schedules, session passes and communication in a single dashboard. Born inside a real football academy, in production from day one.

hero.badgeLive: Actually running a football academy in Barcelona
hero.badgeBot: You get a reply from me, not a bot

story.title: From a real problem to a platform in production
story.description: It didn't start from a blank template. It started with a real football academy that needed to stop losing information in spreadsheets.

steps.title: A real football academy, drowning in spreadsheets
steps.description: A football skills academy in Sant Vicenç dels Horts (Barcelona) tracked students, session passes and attendance across Excel, paper and WhatsApp. Information got lost and nothing scaled.

steps.title: I designed and built a custom backoffice
steps.description: Roles for management, coaches and students. Class scheduling, passes that deduct themselves at roll call, permission-based documentation, internal messaging and notifications. No generic templates.

steps.title: Today it runs the real day-to-day, on its own
steps.description: The platform is in production, running the academy's daily operations. I design, build, deploy, secure and maintain it myself — no agencies, no outside teams involved.

steps.title: Now, the same platform for your academy
steps.description: What started by solving my own problem is now open to football academies, tutoring centers, language schools and personal training studios that need the same thing: a single dashboard that actually works.

features.title: The modules running a real academy
features.description: None of this is a showcase demo: these are the modules running the day-to-day of a real football skills academy, ready for yours.

items.title: Students and coaches
items.description: Profiles, tracking, categories and groups. Every profile reachable in one click, with permissions based on the viewer's role.

items.title: Class scheduling
items.description: One-off and recurring sessions, coach assignment and overlap control, so there are never double bookings.

items.title: Coach observations
items.description: Personal notes and comments from the coach for each session. Every player's history is logged and accessible to management.

items.title: Videos and files
items.description: Upload training or match videos for the coach to review with families or players. Everything organised by team and session.

items.title: Passes and memberships
items.description: They deduct themselves automatically at roll call. No parallel spreadsheets, no manually chasing who still has sessions left.

items.title: Documents and messaging
items.description: Folder-level permissions and internal chat between management, coaches and students, all inside the same platform.

items.title: Notifications and support
items.description: Individual or group notices and an internal ticketing system to resolve issues without losing track.

security.title: Real security, not a marketing line
security.description: Active CSRF protection, login attempt limits, bcrypt-hashed passwords and role-based permissions since the very first deployment. Audited, not just promised.

items.question: How can I see the platform?
items.answer: Book a guided 15-minute demo from the website. I'll walk you through the platform in a session tailored to your academy, so you can see how it fits your real day-to-day. No salespeople — we talk directly.

items.question: Is this a generic template or a real product?
items.answer: It's a platform in real production: it was born to run a football academy's day-to-day and still operates there today, alongside opening up to other academies.

items.question: Who maintains the platform?
items.answer: I design, build, deploy and maintain it directly. There's no agency or outside team involved, so changes and support reach you without middlemen.

items.question: How does it handle student data security?
items.answer: Active CSRF protection, login attempt limits per account and IP, bcrypt-hashed passwords and role-based permissions on every route. It's not a last-minute add-on — it's part of the design from the start.

items.question: Does it work for academies that aren't football?
items.answer: Yes. The demo lets you explore four verticals: football academies, tutoring, languages and personal training. The roles, passes and scheduling model adapt to each one.

items.question: Do you also build websites?
items.answer: Yes. We design and develop professional websites for academies: fast, mobile-first, with local SEO and ready to attract families. If you get the platform and the website together, you have the complete solution with no third parties involved.
